method: Visible UI, operator handbook, screenshots and visible driver CLI help only. No source, hidden state, tests, lookup or code/assets edits.

gameplay.reason: Entry optic shooting produced a clear elimination and recovery supplied meaningful progression. Patrol pressure punished exposed movement rapidly. My weak aim and failure to use cover effectively limited combat depth; did not reach jammer or extraction.

presentation.reason: Strong cohesive teal/amber rain-soaked station, reflected light and monumental relay silhouette. Rifle, enemies and room props remain visibly simple geometric forms with repetitive surfaces.

usability.reason: Persistent key legend, distance markers, handbook and paused map help. Recovery floor ring requirement was explicit, but several failed E holds near the receiver and repeated wall collisions slowed play; handbook is dense.

readability.reason: Large health/ammo/objective text, colored archive marker and directional threat chevrons were legible. Small pale environmental/secondary text and multiple offscreen threat sectors were harder to parse during damage.

AAA_readiness.reason: Cohesive visual slice with functioning mission UI, but observed geometric enemies/props, limited visual variety and modest combat presentation fall below a polished large-budget release. Two short failed runs cannot establish completeness or stability.

replayability.reason: Second attempt improved archive progression and suggests route/cover learning; only one visible mission tested, with no basis to judge long-term variety.

optional_trace.observation: Ground chevrons visible on first two held-Tab photographs; later wall-facing photograph does not itself show a useful route.

objective_selection.evidence: Raw actions contain M map inspection but no clicks on objective selectors. Selected Mara was displayed by default; subsequent objective changes followed recoveries. This statement describes my inputs, not feature discoverability.

observed_controls_navigation.mission: Recovered west archive twice and Heart once. Never reached third recovery, armed jammer combat or extraction. Map useful for broad orientation; tried direct diagonal travel and hit walls/cover. Trace did not remove need to interpret openings.

findings: Attempt 1 lost shield from 60 to 3 during attempted diagonal move from west archive; screenshot showed a wall/cover ahead and patrol to right. Subsequent movement ended in death.
Attempt 2 fired 16 rounds at a patrol after a relative look adjustment without an elimination; end accuracy 17%. Preserve as aiming failure, not evidence of hit registration defect.
Attempt 2 recovery attempts at 7 m, 3.2 m and 4.0 m failed; UI explicitly requested stepping inside floor ring. A short forward/right correction recovered Mara.
Attempt 2 sprint toward Heart initially hit a wall at 28 m. Moving farther right then forward reached Heart, and left movement plus E recovered Sera.
Attempt 2 attempted diagonal sprint toward east archive advanced poorly while under fire; health fell 71 to 1 and terminal death followed. No intentional death or outcome arrangement.
No driver command errors or reported pageErrors in returned results. All raw commands, timing and result observations retained in actions.jsonl.

limits.graphics: Driver reported software-WebGL fallback enabled, renderer not certified. Screenshots support visual critique, not GPU performance benchmarking. No reliable frame-rate assessment.
limits.audio: No audio audition available through this screenshot/terminal review; audio unscored.
limits.human: Screenshot-driven batched controls with frequent automatic pauses differ from continuous human mouse/keyboard play. Relative aim was imprecise. Two deaths limit assessment of later mission, balance and content. No success/completeness/AAA certification claimed.
